war_spear.name: War Spear
war_spear.description: A long-shafted spear designed for battlefield use. Keeps enemies at distance.

silver_serpent_lance.name: Silver Serpent Lance
silver_serpent_lance.description: A flexible lance whose tip weaves like a striking serpent. Mastery of its oscillation can deflect almost any blow.

black_iron_halberd.name: Black Iron Halberd
black_iron_halberd.description: A combined spear and curved blade on a heavy shaft. Devastating sweep attacks but demands tremendous strength.
